visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long wavy brown hair, dressed in a black one-shoulder top and blue trousers, walks into the "CHAUMET PARIS" boutique entrance which features a deep blue facade with gold accents and a bright white backlit logo. (2) Inside, she examines luxury jewelry within glass-topped wooden display cabinets. The interior features soft, warm lighting, floral arrangements, and light-toned furniture. She later sits in a private room with gold-patterned wallpaper and browses a thick catalog book titled "CHAUMET IN MAJESTY". (3) The woman stands in front of a wall featuring various illuminated tiara designs. A male staff member in a black suit brings out a blue velvet tray containing a large diamond-encrusted tiara. Close-up shots highlight pear-shaped diamonds in silver rings. (4) The staff member carefully places a silver tiara on the woman's head while she sits on a beige sofa. She looks surprised and smiles at herself in the mirror. A second, thinner diamond headband is also shown being adjusted on her hair. (5) She admires herself while wearing a sparkling diamond necklace and the tiara. The camera follows her as she walks past glass display tables. Finally, an invitation envelope opens to reveal a cartoon illustration of the woman wearing the same jewelry.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a sophisticated jazz-influenced pop music track featuring a steady rhythmic drum beat, a melodic piano bassline, and light synthesizer accents. There is a total absence of human speech or any environmental noise, providing a studio-clean acoustic atmosphere. (2) As the music continues, the rhythmic structure remains constant with a moderate BPM. No sound effects are audible during the jewelry close-ups or the catalog flipping, emphasizing a post-produced music bed over raw environmental sounds. Spectral brightness is well-balanced. (3) The upbeat melodic theme persists without interruption or vocal overlays. The track maintains high fidelity and tonal purity throughout the jewelry fitting scenes. There are no clicks, rustles, or ambient store chatter, keeping the focus entirely on the musical texture. (4) The audio remains continuous until the end, with the same electronic-pop arrangement accompanying the final shots. No stingers or transition SFX are used between visual cuts, resulting in a smooth, uninterrupted musical experience from start to finish.
